meaning:
πραγματεύομαι
(πρᾶγμα), [in LXX: 3Ki.10:22 B, 3Ki.9:19 A (חָשַׁק), Dan LXX 8:27 (מְלָאכָה ־אֵת עָשָׂה) * ;]
1. to busy oneself.
2. to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: Luk.19:13 (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’
